status: Research prototypes only. No gdev or Ink production source was changed.
method: Frozen current gdev source, Ink library, std and installed compiler; 5 independent replay repetitions per variant/count, rotating execution order; 60 warmup + 180 measured frames, 1280x720, 1/60 second fixed input; full-frame SHA-256 and final-save SHA-256 compared. Guest-only V8 timings, not host/GPU/frame-rate measurements.
fixture: Existing colony save (schema 26), transformed by current performance/fixture_support.blot piles generator, preserving workers; 400 and 2000 separated piles with 40 logical bricks each; compact renderer enabled.
limits: Five paired runs provide a useful local estimate; this was not a complete performance-harness release qualification.
Static-pile shortcut is guarded by terrain epochs, array order/length, compact mode, count, turn, position, lift and squash.
Terrain updates still invalidate all pile heights every sixth fixed step.
Flat structural Stack prototype rejected: 21.5% median paired regression at 2000 piles.
No hardware GPU is exposed (/dev/dri absent; NVIDIA driver unavailable), so renderer cost and displayed FPS are unmeasured.
Concurrent changes in sibling repositories and Ink were excluded by freezing input files and the compiler.
